name: Aster MIMS (Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences)
tagline: NABH / NABL‑accredited tertiary hospital and regional transplant centre for North Kerala
summary: Aster MIMS (Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences) in Govindapuram, Kozhikode is a major NABH‑ and NABL‑accredited tertiary hospital offering multispecialty and multi‑organ transplant programmes for…
description: Aster MIMS is the Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences flagship hospital in Kozhikode, operating as part of the Aster hospital network. The campus (Govindapuram, Mini By‑pass Road) offers tertiary and quaternary care across many specialities.

The hospital holds National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH) and National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) recognition and positions itself as a leading transplant centre in north Kerala.

Visitors and patients find a wide range of services — active kidney and liver transplant programmes, paediatric liver care, multi‑organ transplant capability and established centres of excellence in cardiology, oncology, nephrology and gastro‑liver sciences.
Aster MIMS also supports international patients and runs community engagement programmes around organ donation and transplant outreach.
highlights: NABH‑ and NABL‑accredited tertiary care hospital (Aster MIMS / Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences).
Approved by Kerala State Organ & Tissue Transplant Organisation (K‑SOTTO) for kidney, liver, heart and other organ transplants.
Active renal transplant programme with long experience; multi‑organ and paediatric liver transplants performed.
Part of the Aster hospital network and included in the group's FY2025‑26 reporting and clinical highlights.
Large multispecialty campus serving north Kerala; international‑patient services and community transplant initiatives.

sections.heading: Background
body: Aster MIMS (Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd.) began as a major private multispecialty hospital in Calicut and today operates under the Aster network. Hospital publications and group reports describe the Kozhikode unit as a large multispecialty tertiary facility serving the Malabar region.

The hospital is repeatedly listed on official accreditation lists (NABH) and on the Kerala State Organ & Tissue Transplant Organisation (K‑SOTTO) approved hospitals list for multiple organ transplant types, reflecting its role as a regional referral centre.

sections.heading: Services & specialities
body: Aster MIMS provides broad tertiary‑care services: cardiology and cardiac surgery, nephrology and renal transplant, gastro‑liver sciences (including paediatric liver transplant), oncology, neurosurgery, orthopaedics and obstetrics‑gynaecology among others.

The hospital runs an active kidney transplant programme (publicised patient stories and milestone reports from the hospital) and a multi‑organ transplant programme capable of combined procedures (liver‑kidney, heart‑liver etc.). The centre also promotes organ‑donation awareness and outreach events.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: The hospital campus is on Mini By‑pass Road, Govindapuram P.O., Kozhikode (postal 673016). Outpatient clinics run on scheduled hours; emergency services are available 24×7. For planned speciality or transplant care, book appointments through the hospital’s appointment desk or the international‑patients desk if travelling from abroad.

Confirm admissions, required documents, insurance empanelment and pre‑transplant clearances in advance; transplant and organ donation processes require specific documentation and approvals under state and national rules. For community programmes or patient‑support initiatives check hospital news or contact the hospital directly.

latest.text: Hospital pages and recent reporting highlight paediatric liver transplant activity (including a reported successful infant liver transplant), underlining growth in liver/transplant services.
Jeevanam 2.0 patient‑engagement meetup and launch of 'Jeevadhayini' — an initiative to provide free kidney transplants for underprivileged patients — held at Aster MIMS Calicut.
NABH lists Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences (Aster MIMS, Kozhikode) on its accredited hospitals register (6th Edition, Jan 2025).

visitorInfo.bestTime: Any time — emergency services 24×7; plan outpatient visits on weekdays and book specialist clinics in advance.
visitorInfo.howToReach: Aster MIMS is on Mini By‑pass Road, Govindapuram, Kozhikode. Reachable by taxi from Kozhikode city and the railway station; Calicut International Airport (Karipur) serves the region. Use the hospital’s appointment or international‑patient desk for scheduling.
etiquette: Confirm clinic timings and specialist availability before travel; transplant clinics require prior scheduling and paperwork.
If you are an international patient contact the hospital’s international patients desk for guidance on visas, medical visas, and care pathways.
Verify insurance empanelment and pre‑authorization with your insurer — Aster MIMS lists multiple empanelments but always confirm specific plan coverage.
For transplant or donation queries use the K‑SOTTO approved‑hospital listings and hospital transplant team—legal consent and state approvals are mandatory.
